spec.name: Orange Kitchen Glazed Doughnut
spec.description: A golden, stepped doughnut with a real open center, thick ivory sugar glaze, uneven icing drips and six chunky sugar sprinkles. Rounded bread shoulders taper to a flat y=0 base.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Glazed Doughnut. A ring-shaped glazed doughnut with a real open hole, uneven icing drips and small sprinkles. Use stepped rounded geometry. Actual recipe ingredients: dough, sugar. Let the visible appearance reflect these ingredients.
